notes: Order settlement with gateway retry plus a receipt writer. No test setup, so one 'repo has no test setup' finding (medium, severity.md fixed rule 1) is expected and REAL. PE2 may reasonably be rated medium.

defects.summary: except Exception in settle_order logs a warning and falls through, so a charge that failed (e.g. GatewayUnavailable after all retries) still marks the order PAID with no charge_id and ships it
